author: New China TV
description:
The 2026 Conference on Hongshan Culture took place on August 5-6, gathering distinguished guests from China and abroad to explore the latest perspectives on Hongshan Culture.
Hongshan culture, an important prehistoric archaeological culture dating back approximately 5,000 to 6,000 years, is renowned for the wealth of exquisite jade artifacts, statues, painted pottery and stone tombs discovered at its sites. It had a profound impact on the subsequent development of Chinese civilization.
Now, let's hear what Khaled Nazmy, Egyptian Ambassador to China, from another of the world's great ancient civilizations, has to say.
title: When ancient civilizations meet: Egyptian Ambassador on Hongshan Culture

description:
This May, Lingling (pseudonym), who had been almost completely blind for nearly 20 years, became the first person in China to receive a high-resolution retina-based visual brain-computer interface (BCI) implant in a clinical trial at Zhejiang Provincial People's Hospital. 
More than two months later, she is making steady progress in rehabilitation, learning to recognize letters, practice writing, and move around indoors with increasing confidence.
title: China's visual BCI brings hope to blind mother
